Name: Michael, Son of Baaseiah
Summary: Son of Baaseiah and father of Shimea in Asaph's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:40: Son of Baaseiah and father of Shimea in Asaph's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Michael stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
